verdict.rationale: ANEF is the French digital portal for foreign nationals, so documenting a non-resident path (eligibility, accepted foreign identifiers, extra steps) is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no page content on any of this. The ANEF host returned only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell with under 200 characters of text, and the parent ministry site blocked access with a Cloudflare challenge, so no guidance on eligibility, credentials or extra steps could be observed.
